🎬 Blue Bloods (2010–2024)

Blue Bloods follows the Reagan family, a multigenerational family of law enforcement professionals living in New York City whose lives are deeply connected to protecting their community and upholding the law. At the center is Frank Reagan, the respected New York City Police Commissioner who must balance the enormous responsibilities of leading the NYPD with the challenges of being a father and family patriarch. His oldest son, Danny, is a determined and outspoken detective known for his aggressive investigative style, while his daughter, Erin, works as a prosecutor navigating complicated legal cases and ethical dilemmas. Meanwhile, his youngest son, Jamie, serves as a police officer whose commitment to justice frequently places him in difficult and dangerous situations. From intense criminal investigations and high-stakes arrests to courtroom battles, political conflicts, family disagreements, and unexpected personal challenges, the Reagans constantly confront situations that test their values and loyalty. Their traditional Sunday family dinners provide a meaningful gathering place where different generations discuss difficult decisions, share personal experiences, and occasionally clash over their beliefs. As the family faces professional pressures, emotional losses, and changing relationships, they remain united by their dedication to one another. Combining gripping police investigations, heartfelt family drama, memorable characters, and thought-provoking storytelling, the series explores justice, duty, integrity, loyalty, sacrifice, and the importance of family.

🎭 Genre: Crime • Drama • Police Procedural

⭐ IMDb: 7.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: 42–45 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creators: Robin Green & Mitchell Burgess

📺 Where to Watch: Check Paramount+, Hulu, Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, and Fandango at Home for current streaming or digital purchase availability. Availability varies by region.
